outcome: early initiation of and exclusive breastfeeding (EIBF)
cohort: 288 married women in Khagaria District, Bihar, India who had delivered in the last year.
finding: Institutional delivery and normal vaginal delivery were significantly associated with early initiation of and exclusive breastfeeding (EIBF).
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was significantly associated with EIBF, while delivery in a private institution or by a doctor was associated with lower likelihood of EIBF.
